title: Give OLY-B-O5-01 a mechanism: athena restart and status restarts
summary: Record the existing `athena restart` command (manage.rs) and the `restarts` line of `athena status` as the mechanism for OLY-B-O5-01 in docs/spec.toml, with a measure ending `status: restarts`. Add a test that records a restart and shows the status count rise from 0 to 1, so the requirement's state of the work comes from Athena. Audience: the owner reading the spec gap list.

defaults_applied.how: The test criterion checks that a restart is recorded and the status count changes, not that wiring exists.
fmt, clippy and test must pass.
One spec entry plus one test; no new feature.
The rule is shown by a test on the real restart and status path.
BRIEF.md asks for tagged releases and a changelog, so the change records itself in CHANGELOG.md.

assumptions: Code survey: read crates/athena-core/src/manage.rs (`Manager::restart` validates --cost, redacts, writes an AnyRecord::Restart under records/restarts/ and commits it), crates/athena-core/src/store.rs (Records.restarts loaded from AnyRecord::Restart, sorted by `at`), crates/athena-core/src/status.rs (`restarts: records.restarts.len()`), crates/athena-cli/src/display.rs line 1411 (prints `restarts    N`) and crates/athena-cli/tests/lifecycle.rs (existing restart record fixture). No new record or data file is added under crates/, so check_record_file, AnyRecord and the round-trip test need no change; the existing Restart record type is reused.

Existing code: crates/athena-core/src/manage.rs (restart), crates/athena-core/src/status.rs (restarts), crates/athena-cli/src/display.rs (restarts line) and docs/spec.toml are extended or reused; the new test calls the real restart path and the real status view.

The mechanism is `athena restart` (the user records the cost of restarting their context) plus the `restarts` line of `athena status`, which reports the state from Athena's records. The mechanism is already in the code; the spec records it and a new test pins the behavior. The per-milestone cadence is shown by the count, not enforced. No new refusal rule is added.
Measure label is `status: restarts`, the label of the line `athena status` prints (display.rs). The current measure text is 'The spec gap list; status: requirement' and is replaced.
No figure computed from records for planning cost, landing time, keep rule or refusal rate is changed; planning.rs is untouched, so no real-records range check is needed.
Governance files (athena.toml, defaults.toml, workflows) do not change.

acceptance_criteria.text: docs/spec.toml requirement OLY-B-O5-01 has `mechanism` naming crates/athena-core/src/manage.rs (`restart`) and the `restarts` line of athena status (crates/athena-core/src/status.rs, crates/athena-cli/src/display.rs), no longer "none"; owner stays Athena; and `measure` explains how the requirement is shown and ends with `status: restarts`. Check with Grep on docs/spec.toml.
Every file path named in the new mechanism exists in the repository (checked with ls), and the `restarts` label matches the `restarts    ` line in crates/athena-cli/src/display.rs.

Run `cargo test` for the new test, which records a restart through the real `restart` path (or `athena restart --cost ...`) in a fixture repository and asserts the status view's restarts value goes from 0 to 1 and `athena status` prints `restarts    1`. The test fails if `Manager::restart` does not write the record or if status stops counting restarts.
Run `cargo fmt --check`, `cargo clippy --all-targets` and `cargo test`; all pass.
The diff touches only docs/spec.toml and test files under crates/ (plus minimal non-figure code if the test needs it); crates/athena-core/src/status/planning.rs is not changed.

out_of_scope: Changing the planning cost, landing time or other figures status prints (crates/athena-core/src/status/planning.rs)
Enforcing a restart per milestone or on an efficiency drop with a new gate or refusal
Editing records/ or other requirements in docs/spec.toml
departures: Reference forecast kept; the work is a spec edit plus one test and touches no records measure.
